items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: I would express to them what Page had told me, about how we could should team... Page'll sit down and tell the guys, 'Now listen, we gotta' get the balance.'

ctx.x: But we used to have our conferences and talk, and I would express to them what Page had told me, about how we could should team, how that bass drum drummer's foot shouldn't be too heavy, and how the bass player should stay away from trying to run every chord that goes along, but get a straight line where you can push, and Max McShann was naturally talented in how to play with the band, anyway.

We began to find each other, and it was during our first year that lots of times the horns would lay out -- McShann had the horns lay out and the rhythm section and would just walk for maybe five or ten minutes. Just McShann cooking on the piano and --
